parsed.restated: ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < (1 : ℝ) / 2 → Filter.limsup (fun n : ℕ => Real.logb 2 (MetricCodes.Hamming.codeNumber n (Nat.ceil (δ * (n : ℝ))) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)) Filter.atTop < MetricCodes.binaryEntropy ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - Real.sqrt (δ * (1 - δ)))
parsed.proof: first | exact Iff.rfl | (unfold MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryRate MetricCodes.Hamming.classicalRate MetricCodes.Hamming.classicalParameter; exact Iff.rfl) | (simp only [MetricCodes.Hamming.binaryRate, MetricCodes.Hamming.classicalRate, MetricCodes.Hamming.classicalParameter])
parsed.english: For every relative distance δ strictly between 0 and 1/2, the limsup of (log₂ A(n, ⌈δn⌉))/n, where A(n,d) is the maximum size of a binary code of length n and minimum distance d, is strictly less than H₂(1/2 − √(δ(1−δ))), the classical (MRRW-type) entropy bound.
parsed.why_clearer: It unfolds binaryRate, classicalRate and classicalParameter into the explicit limsup of log₂(max code size)/n and the entropy expression, with δ and the hypotheses made explicit as quantifiers.
